description: Machine-checkable comparability contract for the two benchmark tracks (WAVE-30C section 2). Both tracks MUST share every field in 'shared' (byte-identical), and may differ ONLY within each track file's 'per_track' section. Any other divergence invalidates the comparison. Validated by tests/benchmark/harness/tracks.validate_comparability and the benchmark-deterministic CI gate; no live provider call is involved.

shared.scoring: state-based oracles (tests/benchmark/harness/oracles.py); Runner.verdict_matches_expected gate; identical for both tracks

comparability_rule: A result set from Track A and a result set from Track B are comparable iff they were produced against the identical task bank (manifest_sha256 + scenario_id_set_sha256 + family_set_sha256), scored by the identical oracles, emitted under output_schema_version benchmark.v1, and run under identical shared_limits. Provider/model identity, credential source, cost model and the EUR budget are recorded per-track and are the ONLY sanctioned differences. Latency, throughput, failure and cost are measured and reported separately per track and never averaged across tracks.

notes.track_a: Local/ECO, zero cloud-API cost, excluded from the EUR 10 campaign budget; the exact model tag is Owner/registry-supplied (OWNER_MODEL_IDENTIFIER_REQUIRED) and 'Qwen 3.5 9B' is not a canonical identifier.
notes.track_b: One Owner-selected non-Anthropic cloud provider (OWNER_SELECTION_REQUIRED); file-based credential; bounded by the EUR 10 cumulative campaign ledger.
